market_pulse.note: Near $61,700 shortly after the U.S. stock close Thursday, down about 1.5% over 24 hours and at its weakest level since July (COINOTAG).
About $1,754 around 12:20 p.m. ET Thursday, down 0.49% over 24 hours (CryptoTicker; TokenPost).
About $2.13 trillion, down about 2% over 24 hours, as of early Thursday afternoon ET (Altcoin Buzz).
About 59% Thursday afternoon, up from 58.9% in the morning (Altcoin Buzz; Ted Pillows).

themes.title: Stock selloff drags Bitcoin lower
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell from about $63,900 at the U.S. open toward $61,700 as the Dow lost more than 1,100 points despite Anthropic's strong debut (TokenPost; COINOTAG; Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Seventh weekly loss in view
themes.summary: Bitcoin is down about 12% to 14% over seven days and on track for a seventh straight weekly decline (COINOTAG; CryptoTicker; Altcoin Buzz).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded about $2.6 billion in net outflows so far in November (KuCoin).

themes.title: Rate-hike expectations weigh
themes.summary: Prediction markets put the odds of a quarter-point Fed hike in December at about 91% to 92%, and Governor Waller floated a half-point move (KuCoin; Altcoin Buzz; CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Extreme fear, $372M liquidated
themes.summary: The Fear and Greed Index sits at 10 to 11, in extreme fear, and about $372 million of crypto positions were liquidated on Thursday (The Daily Coins; Altcoin Buzz; COINOTAG).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin near $61,700 and Ether near $1,754; Ether is down more than 15% over seven days (COINOTAG; CryptoTicker; Altcoin Buzz).

categories.name: Altcoins
categories.note: XRP traded near $0.96, down 1.66%, and Solana near $72.96, down 0.73%, around midday ET (CryptoTicker).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: Mixed: ether.fi gained about 11% over 24 hours in the morning while Curve DAO Token fell about 4.3% (The Daily Coins).

categories.name: Stablecoins
categories.note: Stablecoin supply stood at about $286.4 billion (The Daily Coins).

watch_list.why: Bitcoin has slipped below the roughly $62,000 floor that held for weeks; analysts cite $60,000 as the next support and $64,000 to $66,000 as resistance (Ted Pillows; KuCoin; COINOTAG).
LayerZero (ZRO) and KAITO token unlocks and Japan's October CPI are scheduled for Nov. 20 (KuCoin).
Markets price a December rate increase as highly likely, a backdrop that has weighed on crypto (Ted Pillows; Altcoin Buzz).

movers.name: BTW
movers.note: Up about 32% over 24 hours as of early afternoon ET (Altcoin Buzz).

movers.name: Pi Network (PI)
